title: Architecture shapes event boundaries: Theta dynamics of event segmentation during spatial transitions
authors: M Dumesnil, N Djebbara-Bozo, Z Djebbara
abstract: Investigates neural dynamics associated with event boundaries during active navigation through architectural transitions using mobile EEG and VR. Reports a robust theta-band power increase over temporo-occipital regions after passing through a doorway.

title: Predictive processing and spatial cognition in architectural environments
abstract: Examines active inference models applied to architectural navigation tasks, focusing on threshold events and spatial transitions.
